name: 彭尉祖
objective: This course introduces fundamental concepts of heat transfer, with emphasis on govern equations for three thermal pathways, including heat conduction, heat convection, and radiation. Topics cover multiple heat transfer conditions to equip students with the ability to analyze and design various thermal systems based on appropriate theory of heat transfer.
schedule:
Week 1 : Overview of heat transfer
Week 2 : Basic principles
Week 3 : One-dimensional steady-state heat conduction
Week 4 : One-dimensional steady-state heat conduction
Week 5 : Three-dimensional steady-state heat conduction
Week 6 : Transient heat conduction
Week 7 : Heat convection
Week 8 : Midterm exam
Week 9 : Heat convection
Week 10 : Forced external heat convection
Week 11 : Forced internal heat convection
Week 12 : Forced internal heat convection
Week 13 : Natural convection
Week 14 : Natural convection
Week 15 : Radiation
Week 16 : Radiation
Week 17 : Radiation
Week 18 : Final exam
scorePolicy:
Attendance 10%
In-class quiz 20%
Mid-term exam 30% 
Final exam 40%
materials: Yunus A. Çengel,  Afshin J. Ghajar, "Heat and Mass Transfer: Fundamentals & Applications”, 6th Ed. in SI Units, Graw-Hill, 2020
